hints.title: Right-to-Left Monotonic Scanning
hints.text: Traverse the sequence from the tail towards the head to maintain the maximum score observed so far.

hints.title: Replacement Condition Evaluation
hints.text: Any student strictly surpassed by a subsequent peer score will trigger a replacement event.

hints.title: Tally Cumulative Replacements
hints.text: Increment the replacement count for each dominated element while updating the running extreme.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of students in queue
complexity.notes: Single reverse linear pass maintaining running maximum suffix score.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating rounds step-by-step causes quadratic overhead on descending runs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single integer tracks the running maximum without auxiliary lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that a reverse scan computes dominated elements in O(N) time.
